checked_profile.scope: EssentialTerm Plus brochure, edition September 2024, retrieved September 14, 2026. The main consumer page did not expose readable product details in this check. This document check does not confirm current sales availability or unchanged terms.

facts.label: Product and issuer
facts.text: The September 2024 brochure identifies EssentialTerm Plus as term life issued by Pruco Life Insurance Company, subject to state availability. It lists 10-, 15-, 20- and 30-year terms with premiums level for the selected term.

facts.label: Conversion and renewal
facts.text: The brochure describes conversion to a permanent product during the term or until age 70, whichever comes first. Continuing term coverage after the initial period can reduce the death benefit and increase premiums. Confirm the current contract rules.

facts.label: Medical underwriting
facts.text: PruFast Track may bypass exams and labs for eligible applicants. The brochure lists ages 18–60 and $100,000–$3 million for that pathway; these are not overall policy limits or guaranteed approval.
